scope.notes: DESIGN.md frontmatter owns primitives. Observed values only; no synthetic tonal ramps or unimplemented components. Snippets use existing markup and variable fallbacks; Figtree is supplied by the local page font.

motion.name: tour-progress
motion.purpose: Vertical progress rule; transition disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: tour-step-duration
motion.purpose: Autostarts once when first visible; pause/select/reset cancel the timer. Stops after six steps, offscreen or hidden. No automatic resume and no audio.

hairline-edge.purpose: Figure-local --hairline-edge; not a replacement page accent.

behavior.initial: Paused while offscreen; autostarts once on first visible entry unless reduced motion is enabled.
behavior.play: Iniciar animação → Pausar → Repetir animação after completion.
behavior.select: Any of the six steps; cancels playback.
behavior.visibility: Offscreen or document hidden pauses; explicit activation required to resume.
behavior.fallback: All six complete approved texts remain in HTML. Failed module loading leaves them visible; reduced motion hides the interactive panel and destroys the figure, including live preference changes.
behavior.artBranch: Fotos → ChatGPT → Personagens ilustrados → Implementação remains visible outside the interactive panel; accent at step 3 only.

technicalCase.preserved: Game runtime, screenshot assets and workflow autoplay.

components.name: Delivery workflow
components.description: Static preview of the actual six-step selector in Implementação state; production flow-tour.js wires selection to the Hairline stage and polite caption. Replaces the unused legacy .workflow grid.
components.css: .ds-tour{font-family:Figtree,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18212b)}.ds-tour button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0969da);outline-offset:4px}.ds-flow-steps{position:relative;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-rows:repeat(6,minmax(56px,auto));gap:8px}.ds-flow-steps:before,.ds-flow-steps:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:28px;bottom:28px;left:15px;width:1px;background:var(--line,#d8dee4);pointer-events:none}.ds-flow-steps:after{background:var(--accent,#0969da);transform:scaleY(.4);transform-origin:top;transition:transform .35s ease-out}.ds-flow-steps li{z-index:1;min-width:0}.ds-flow-steps button{border:0;background:transparent;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;min-height:56px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:8px 0;font:500 15px/1.4 Figtree,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#52606d);cursor:pointer}.ds-flow-steps button span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 32px;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d8dee4);border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:12px}.ds-flow-steps button[aria-current]{color:var(--ink,#18212b);font-weight:650}.ds-flow-steps button[aria-current] span{background:var(--ink,#18212b);color:var(--surface,#ffffff);border-color:var(--ink,#18212b)}.ds-flow-steps button[data-passed=true] span{color:var(--accent,#0969da);border-color:var(--accent,#0969da)}.ds-flow-steps button:hover{color:var(--accent,#0969da)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-flow-steps{gap:4px;grid-template-rows:repeat(6,minmax(64px,auto))}.ds-flow-steps button{font-size:13px;gap:8px;min-height:64px}.ds-flow-steps button span{flex-basis:24px;height:24px;font-size:11px}.ds-flow-steps:before,.ds-flow-steps:after{left:11px;top:32px;bottom:32px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-flow-steps:after{transition:none}}

components.html:
1. Pedido

    Pelo Telegram, o responsável solicita uma alteração e envia os materiais necessários.

  2. Revisão

    Textos e mudanças são revisados. A direção e as aprovações permanecem humanas.

  3. Implementação

    No MacBook Air M1, o Hermes Agent trabalha nos arquivos com apoio do Codex.

  4. Testes

    O resultado é verificado no navegador, em diferentes tamanhos de tela.

  5. Publicação

    A alteração é registrada no Git e publicada no GitHub Pages.

  6. Conferência pública

    O site publicado é conferido para confirmar que a versão correta está disponível.

narrative.overview:
A sober software-engineering article: white surface, graphite hierarchy, slate supporting text and blue interaction states. This replaces the former playful Backstage world, following `editorial/backstage-design.md`. Source of truth: `docs/backstage/backstage.css` and `docs/backstage/index.html`.

Scope is exclusively `docs/backstage/`. The illustrated game retains its own colors, fonts and behavior in `docs/style.css`; the real game captures retain their original appearance. No new branding, components or tonal ramps are inferred.
keyCharacteristics: Local Figtree throughout, restrained rectangular controls and fine rules.
Desktop contents navigation beside a readable article; mobile single-column reading.
Genuine screenshot evidence, semantic architecture and ordered delivery workflow.
dos: Do preserve the implemented neutral palette, local Figtree and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep screenshot evidence and semantic diagrams readable across breakpoints.
Do keep Backstage styles isolated from the illustrated game.
donts: Don't restore the superseded playful Backstage palette, display font or organic frames.
Don't recolor evidence images or change approved narrative to suit the layout.
Don't invent token ramps, component states or application behavior absent from the source.
